about: Synthetic data only: the committed toy trial and one stay built in research/wiring_fixture.py. It is a golden file for the wiring slice: the backend tests its own feature builder, forward pass, confidence check and policy state machine against the research code, bin by bin. Each bin's minute is the END of the 15-minute bin, as in the trial format, so the backend's bin_at start is minute - 15. A bin entry exists for every 15-minute boundary from the first row to the last; a gap has row null and every other field null. Row values are the stored values of the research Row (diastolic is not read by NEWS2 and the Row does not hold it). Features are float32 values written as the Python repr of the float32 converted to float. p is research.plain_student.forward on those float32 values. check is research.confidence.check(p, t, q) with 'not sure' written as not_sure. z is the policy's clipped z per vital in the order of constants.policy_vitals. A NOT RANKED bin has student and policy null (no p, the policy is not alerting and its run is reset). The file holds what the research code computes on every scored bin. It does NOT apply the product's extra gates (ruling 10: nothing is computed while the baseline forms; ruling 7: the 672-bin cap). baseline_formed says, per vital, whether baseline_finding returns a finding on the series up to that bin, so the backend can test its own gate. All toy stays are kept.
